AboutUs.About: Welcome to Lorcle – the daily puzzle challenge for all fans of the Disney Lorcana TCG!
AboutUs.About2: Inspired by the popular game Wordle, this site lets you guess a Lorcana card each day using clues like card type, ink color, rarity, and more. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, it's a fun way to test your knowledge of the game.
AboutUs.Lorcana: Disney Lorcana is a collectible card game featuring beloved Disney characters, magical artwork, and strategic gameplay. Designed for both new and experienced TCG players, it offers a rich world full of lore and competition.
AboutUs.WhatToExpect: Daily Lorcana based puzzles and a variety of gamemodes to come
AboutUs.WhatToExpect2: Clues based on card properties (type, ink, set, rarity, etc.)
AboutUs.WhatToExpect3: A Wordle-like experience tailored to Lorcana fans
AboutUs.WhatToExpect4: A fun challenge to share with your friends and the community
AboutUs.Why: As a Lorcana enthusiast, I wanted a way to combine my love for the game with a fun, brain-teasing experience. That’s how Lorcana Wordle was born as a mix of trivia, memory, and daily excitement for the Lorcana community.
AboutUs.Contact: Have feedback, suggestions, or just want to say hi? Reach out via the contact page or email. I’d love to hear from you!
